text:
devin: quick - booking incidental wifi at hotel for 2 nights. policy says wifi is reimbursable on biz nights. can i put it on company card even if the first night is personal?
tori: if the wifi charge covers a business night and you used company card only for business nights, yes. if the company card is used during a personal stay, add note. however, if it's single charge covering personal + business nights, pro-rate or submit actual with explanation.
aj: precise approach: if company card charged once for entire stay and it includes personal nights, travel team prefers you pay personal portion on your own then be reimbursed for the business portion. otherwise we accept proof of prorated cost from hotel.
devin: expensify flow for prorating?
expensebot: automated: "Upload hotel folio PDF, tag line items for room nights, add comment 'Prorated: personal night 2026-07-01' and indicate business nights count. Finance will validate."
devin: thanks. also wifi receipts are a pain, sometimes bundled. good to know.
